extent_statements.source_scope: The 580 images total 72,963,221 bytes:578 JPEG and 2 PNG. There are 582 archive members including project-created sequence.json and ATTRIBUTION.txt. PP 1 and PP 586 show exterior binding; PP 2 carries a modern library barcode/accession label, and PP 5 has stamps and ownership/shelfmark handwriting. These are copy provenance, not 1498 book text. A thumbnail rights screen found no extensive modern creative insert, but does not date every annotation. Complete offered delivery does not establish physical-volume completeness or full textual collation. No OCR or transcription is included. Per-cover SHA, byte extent and separate legal-exception dispositions are recorded in sequence.json. The two covers remain acquired and retained; none of the 580 source images is withheld.

canonical_artifacts.rights_basis: United States: the 1498 printed Latin missal and its historical typography are public domain by publication date. These are mechanical reproductions of that identified copy. U.S. Copyright Office Compendium 313.4(A), third edition Chapter 300 pp. 26–27, treats scanning an existing literary work as mere copying without new copyrightable authorship; the whole official 39-page chapter and the full 1,396-page Compendium are retained separately. The fetched Google Books Terms of Service section 2 preserves uses permitted under the U.S. Copyright Act; it is contextual wording, not a general scan redistribution licence or a complete current-contract analysis. Google attribution and incidental library labels, accession stamps and ownership marks remain unchanged, distinct from the 1498 printing and excluded from Triptych CC BY 4.0. Their incidental preservation for noncommercial source verification rests on the project reading of 17 U.S.C.107: functional or factual character, small incidental extent and no substitute market or endorsement. The settled Google-notice record at src/sources/inventories/google-usage-guidelines-rights-v1.toml does not itself decide direct-scan rights. No status outside the United States is asserted. The two undated exterior-binding views PP 1 and PP 586 have a separate exception basis: their photographic originality and binding date remain unestablished; Compendium 909.1–909.3(A), full-manual artifactpages 576–577, prevents inferring photograph rights from the subject. Their exact plain functional 575-pixel documentary surfaces are retained under 17 U.S.C.107 for noncommercial physical-copy identification, acknowledging whole-image use and documentary-purpose overlap, low expressive character and no identified substitute market. This is a bounded project legal reading, not public-domain cover/photo clearance. The overall package therefore uses legal-exception as its mixed machine-readable rights status; the 1498 printed text retains its independent public-domain status.
